assets.title: The Oath Terraces
assets.question: Does Vigil feel hopeful and civic here, or should its imperial ambition be more visible?
assets.note: Proposed city and architecture; no capital or exclusive faction territory is established.
assets.hook: An old imperial aqueduct feeds a new city's public cisterns; an oath patrol escorts returning carts.
assets.scene: A wide high vantage over a prosperous terraced HIGH FANTASY city associated with the Sunmane Oath. Ivory limestone dwellings, warm plaster arcades, copper-gold public roofs, a repaired old imperial aqueduct entering a practical working cistern plaza. The city grew AFTER the fall; old foundations carry modest new buildings. It has markets, cloth awnings, gardens and open squares, not just fortress and cathedral. In the left foreground a tiny lionfolk oath rider in ivory and muted blue helps guide two provision carts beneath a narrow arch; ordinary humans carry water below. Warm morning sunlight against a crisp pale blue sky, lavender shadows, gold roof accents only. Main visual subject is the cascade of terraces and water, framed asymmetrically with distant farmland breathing room. Painterly detail strongest on cistern and cart activity, roofs become broad shapes with distance. Hope and civic responsibility with a suggestion of ordered authority. No red capes, sunburst plastered on everything, shining divine apparition or grand battle.

assets.title: The House That Keeps a Light
assets.question: Should the Still Flame feel more like a practical healing order or a religious institution?
assets.note: Proposed hospice; healing does not settle the source of magic.
assets.hook: The hospice treats travellers from opposing causes while an old sanctuary remains silent.
assets.scene: Wide INTERIOR of a Still Flame roadside hospice built inside the surviving side aisle of an old sanctuary. Functional clean beds, folded linens, a low fire warming water, patched pale curtains. At lower right an older dark-skinned human healer kneels to bind the wrist of a tired young orc traveller while a human apprentice turns a basin toward a shaft of late afternoon light. A lionfolk civilian sleeps in the quiet middle ground. A great EMPTY unlit niche lies at upper left, materially present but subordinate. Warm light from the low brazier and a small high opening of cool sky connect the workers; ivory stone, soft apricot, blue-grey linen and warm copper. Their gazes and hands are fully occupied in treatment, simple painted faces, gentle purposeful gestures. Spacious slightly low viewpoint lets the building and human kindness share importance. No hovering god, halo, glorious magical cure, blood, crowded emergency or copying the existing Still Flame painting's staging.

assets.question: Should Artificer inventions primarily improve daily life, or feel stranger and more ambitious?

assets.title: Experiment — Dominion in White
assets.question: Can bright, austere beauty communicate Dominion more effectively than darkness?
assets.note: A speculative salt-basin court; tests a wider palette and architectural vocabulary.
assets.hook: The power to grant water becomes the architecture of authority.
assets.scene: EXPERIMENT: a Dominion Ashen Court administrative seat at the edge of an immense pale SALT BASIN, viewed from within a shaded low arcade. Austere ivory and chalk-pink horizontal architecture around a single narrow black reflecting channel; broad hand-trowelled surfaces, no gothic towers or skull ornament. One very small official seated in deep shade holds a tarnished silver water measure while several distant petitioners wait outside a low gate. assets.title: Experiment — Roots in the Dry Country
assets.question: Does Genesis work beyond deep green forests, in a culture of scarce water and careful shade?
assets.note: Proposed dry-country practice; no universal culture or alderkin biology is decided.
assets.hook: A small community protects runoff and seasonal growth rather than a permanent green canopy.
assets.scene: EXPERIMENT: Genesis community in a DRY HIGH PLATEAU, not forest. Low woven shade canopies and earth-plaster shelters follow shallow contour channels built to catch seasonal rain. Medium-wide view from above a cool shaded work area into a brilliantly sunlit ochre basin. Main action: an ordinary human woman in pale practical clothes and a three-metre ALDERKIN jointly lift a stone sluice so a little captured water reaches young plants. Alderkin living trunk anatomy is asymmetric and rootlike, sparse seasonal leaves, knot eyes, no human face carved into wood; do not invent cactus body. Human child tends an open seed tray in background. Explore pale ochre, desaturated turquoise shade, copper earth and tiny olive growth; deliberate large, dry scumbled brush shapes, small luminous water accents. Spiritual feeling through stewardship rather than magic. No palace, colossal tree, anthropomorphic cactus, giant beast, lush jungle or literal divine blessing.

assets.title: Experiment — The Unmeasured Distance
assets.use: Metaphysical visual direction / possible late-game mood
assets.question: Is this degree of abstraction useful for the gods' distance, or should the unseen remain less literal?
assets.note: Creator-facing metaphor only. Characters do not know this truth; no crossing, destination or cause of the Cataclysm is established.
assets.hook: A surviving connection can be real while the distance remains impossible to understand.
assets.scene: EXPERIMENT / CREATOR-ONLY METAPHYSICAL PAINTING. Abstract the distance between mortal world and silent gods WITHOUT revealing any god, primordial creature or physical portal. Bottom left a very small indistinct human summoner stands at the limit of a dark grounded plane, a tiny visible golden scar on the wrist. One impossibly fine gold thread travels into enormous layered regions of pale turquoise, deep ultramarine, wine-violet and warm pearl, disappearing and reappearing across discontinuous painted space. At far upper right a restrained distant warm luminosity has NO palace or humanoid form. The vast gap is primordial chaos portrayed through broad curved and fractured passages of translucent oil colour, not space stars, tentacles or literal storm clouds. Radical asymmetry, enormous quiet intervals, economical marks, beautiful selective luminous glazing and some raw matte strokes. Compared with the existing Across the Silence composition, shift the distant light HIGH and make space feel discontinuous instead of a mountain valley. Melancholy and possible hope, not triumphant successful crossing. No legible diagram, infinity symbols, explanatory text, battle or settled cause of the Cataclysm.
